verdict.rationale: The CLI ships a documented `skills init [name]` command that scaffolds a new SKILL.md template, and the accompanying specification explicitly requires YAML frontmatter (with name/description used by agents at discovery time) plus a validation tool (`skills-ref validate`) to check compliance, so a developer can author a skill without reverse-engineering existing ones. Missing for 10: a full worked example showing the exact frontmatter fields in the generated template, and independent/hands-on corroboration that `skills init` output is immediately usable without further edits.
